front: CZ 457: where is the safety?
back: Behind the bolt handle, right side (95%, CZ manual Fig. 1 and 4).

front: CZ 457 safety: which position is ON?
back: Pushed back, white dot uncovered. It locks the trigger (95%, CZ manual page 7).

front: Can the CZ 457 bolt open with the safety ON?
back: Yes. CZ lists it as a safe unloading feature (95%, manual page 4).

front: Where is the CZ 457 magazine catch, and which way?
back: At the front of the magazine. Press it rearward (95%, manual page 5).

front: Where is the CZ 457 bolt catch?
back: Left side of the receiver. Bolt open, press it, pull the bolt out (95%, manual page 9, Fig. 10).

front: What does the cocking indicator show?
back: Striker cocked: its rear sticks out past the plug. See or feel it. It does not show if a round is chambered (95%).

front: How far does the CZ 457 bolt handle lift?
back: 60 degrees (95%, manual page 4).

front: Do CZ 455 magazines and barrels fit the CZ 457?
back: Yes, same interface (95%, manual page 4).

front: Loading a CZ magazine: where does each round go first?
back: On the follower, base just ahead of the lips; press down and back to the rear wall (95%, manual page 5).

front: Unloading the CZ 457: the order?
back: Point safe, safety ON, magazine out, open the bolt, PROVE chamber and well empty (95%, manual page 6).

front: Click, no bang. What now?
back: Keep it pointed safe 30 seconds, then eject and examine the round. Light dent: gunsmith (95%, CZ rule 19).

front: Is a 10 round .22 LR magazine legal in a bolt action rimfire?
back: Yes. The 5 round limit is for semi automatic centre fire; rimfire magazines are excluded (95%, SOR/98-462 Part 4 s. 3, my reading).

front: Factory zero of the CZ 457 iron sights?
back: 50 m (95%, manual page 8).

front: CZ 457 iron sights: which adjusts windage, which elevation?
back: Rear sight: windage. Front sight, two screws: elevation (95%, manual page 8).

front: What does a scope mount onto on the CZ 457?
back: The 11 mm dovetail on the receiver, or a Weaver rail (95%, manual page 8).

front: 50 m zero with a 40 gr .22 LR: how flat?
back: Within about 1.5 cm from 15 to 55 m; 19 cm low at 100 m (75%, model).

front: Quarter MOA click at 50 m moves the hit about?
back: 0.36 cm. At 25 m, 0.18 cm (95%, geometry).

front: Dot size at 50 m that matches deer vitals at 200 m?
back: 5 cm. Dot = 20 cm x 50 / deer distance (95%, geometry; vitals 70%).

front: Which game birds may a .22 rimfire hunt in BC?
back: Grouse, ptarmigan or turkey only (99%, synopsis page 13, note 2).

front: Region 2 grouse season and limit?
back: Sept 10 to Dec 15; 10 a day, 30 in possession, sooty, ruffed, spruce together (99%, page 28).

front: Region 2 snowshoe hare: where and when?
back: MUs 2-5 to 2-19, Aug 1 to Apr 30, 10 a day. None in 2-2, 2-3, 2-4 (99%, page 28).

front: Shot only area: can you use the .22?
back: No. Shotgun only (99%, Closed Areas Regulation, Region 2).

front: Cleaning rod: which end of the CZ barrel?
back: From the chamber. Brush all the way through before reversing (95%, manual page 10).

front: When does CZ say to clean the 457?
back: Each use, when wet, soon after shooting, at least yearly; monthly in harsh climates (95%, manual page 9).

front: How far may you strip the CZ 457 yourself?
back: Magazine out, bolt out. Anything more: a gunsmith (95%, manual page 9).

front: CZ 457 stock screw torque?
back: 3.5 Nm, parts 73 and 74 (95%, manual page 9).

front: CZ 457 trigger screws A, B, C?
back: A pull weight and B travel after the shot (stock off); C in the trigger, travel before the shot (95%, manual page 7).

front: Standard CZ 457 trigger range?
back: 8 to 15 N, factory 11.1 to 14 N. Comfort trigger 5 to 7 N (95%, manual page 7).

front: What holds a CZ 457 barrel in?
back: Two barrel screws at the front of the receiver (80%, all4shooters; parts list item 2).

front: Cut a rifle's barrel under 457 mm: legal class?
back: Prohibited firearm (adapted rifle, Criminal Code s. 84) (99%).

front: A suppressor in Canada?
back: Prohibited device: anything designed to muffle or stop the sound of a firearm (99%, Criminal Code s. 84).

front: Entry rimfire scope price checked 2026-10-23?
back: Vortex Crossfire II 2 to 7x32 Rimfire: $199.99 CAD at Cabela's Canada (65%).
